description: Resolve a human gene symbol, previous symbol, alias, HGNC, Ensembl or NCBI Gene identifier. Returns exact, alias, ambiguous, not_found or withdrawn status with candidates and identity_snapshot_id. Use a selected HGNC gene_id and snapshot_id with get_gene_profile. Gene-plus-HGVS and variant expressions use classify_germline_variant.
